question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "Distant".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• 'Distant' means a long way away or not closely related.
 
• Example- *She travels to distant parts of the world.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__*

 
• * *Farther means distance but it is a comparative adverb.

 
 
• Example - *The red car is farther than the blue car.*
 
 
 
• Further means more or to a greater degree.
 
 
• Example - *Are there any further questions?*
 
 
 
• Near means almost, not far away, close etc.
 
 
• Example - *She lives nearby the market.*
